purpose: Bind the public invitation entry to distinct completed and expired terminal states from the existing owner view, with no new command or protocol.

consumerBindings.businessTask: Understand an invitation only while it can still proceed; receive a clear terminal result after completion or expiry.

controlFacts.owner-status: Existing PublicInvitationView status and expiresAt are authoritative.
controlFacts.entry-interaction-form: Completed and expired views expose login return only.
controlFacts.terminal-command-denial: No consent, OTP, credentials, or completion command is rendered from a terminal state.
